summary: Currenc Group Inc. (Nasdaq: CURR, a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer) reported via Form 6-K that on October 1, 2026 the High Court of Malaya made absolute a charging order over 100,465 Tranglo Sdn. Bhd. shares held by subsidiary Seamless Group Inc. Creditor Ripple Markets APAC enforced a Singapore summary judgment of April 17, 2025 (HC/OC 628/2024) for US$23,952,480 principal plus late charges; Seamless was guarantor. From October 7, 2026, RMA may seek a sale of the charged shares. Watch enforcement timing, valuation disputes and any Tranglo stake disposal risk.
